description_en: Publish a specific version of a driver
kebab_example: aliyun iot release-edge-driver-version --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --driver-id fec565038d7544978d9aed5c1a000000 --driver-version 1.2.0 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReleaseEdgeDriverVersion

parameters.description_en: The instance ID. Do not specify this parameter for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

parameters.description_en:
The driver ID. To obtain the ID, go to the **Driver Management** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), and move the mouse pointer over the target driver name.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) API to obtain the driver ID.
parameters.description_zh:
驱动ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**驱动管理**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~)接口获取。
